format: UCWDC Prelims promotion and Semi-Finals retirement, ties at the cut

source.quote_free_summary: Contestants are promoted from each Preliminaries round (or retired from each Semi-Finals round) based on a designated number set by the Contest Coordinator, plus ties if any occur.

requirement: A UCWDC profile must promote the designated number plus all ties at the cut, and must record what happens when that count exceeds a heat or floor capacity (the rule states no capacity exception).
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. A blocker to activating any future UCWDC scoring profile. A future UCWDC engine must be independently verified, separately versioned and evaluated under OD-24; the Studio engine is not modified for it.
interpretation_notes: Citation reconciled: the audit inventory calls this Rule #1.4 (p.2), which matches the printed text (item 4 under Rule #1). It is not 'Rule #4': the standalone Rule #4 (p.3) is the majority-size tiebreaker. The earlier CFD statement that UCWDC is silent on ties was corrected. Studio blocks over-capacity ties (OD14-DF-0001) and does not claim this rule; Studio policy and UCWDC differ when ties exceed capacity. No UCWDC advance-plus-ties behavior exists.
decision_refs: OD-14 (owner decision 2026-11-23, Option A: preserve the Studio over-capacity tie block; retrospective audit PR #795)
